column1: # RECURSIVE SCHEMAS (docs/design/RECURSION.0.md): where RefVal's
# prefix test used to answer path_cycle, it answers a RECURSIVE
# RESIDUAL -- `$.Node` inside `Node` (and `%t` inside `%t`) simply
# means the fixpoint. The residual expands ONE LEVEL PER MEET WITH
# CONCRETE STRUCTURE (per destination, ADR-005's clone discipline), is
# SYMBOLIC in canon and the aon1- hash (the mu-form, finite and
# round-tripping), and REFUSES at generation when a demanded position
# never met data (recursion_unexpanded) -- so guardedness is EMERGENT:
# `next?:` drops, `*null | $.Node` generates, a required recursive
# field with no data refuses at the instance. Termination is
# structural descent on finite data, with the depth budget as backstop
# (recursion_budget). VALUE cycles (mutual `a:$.b b:$.a`, chains,
# func-routed) are the chase detector's and still refuse path_cycle.
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md).

# --- A residual meets a kind, a disjunction, another residual (G12 16)
# A kind picks the body's branch as structure does, so the residual
# expands one level against it; a disjunction distributes over the
# residual; another residual leaves nothing to wait for but data, so
# the meet settles. A rider over any of these resolves, and a residual
# of another alias reaches what that alias's declaration reaches. The
# meta-schema is built this way: each vocabulary is a titled
# `boolean|{...}` recursive through its root. A spread's copy fails at
# its own key. Each residual prints as the knot no canon row can pin
# (alias.tsv), so these pin generation.
